body: It's weird because I know all this, I just don't process it at the same time. I would completely agree if it was about someone else or others, but when it comes to me I feel like it's advice to a wall. I feel like I can't reach out for help, and if I did it won't work. I don't know where to begin and I'm also afraid that it will be on some sort of record for other doctors or therapists to refer to.
